title: documentation/1.0/query
description: Searches the registry's catalog of protocol definitions. All filters are optional and must all match; an empty body lists everything.

id.description: Message ID, unique to the sender.

from.description: Sender DID. REQUIRED when the message is authcrypted.

thid.description: Thread id; the id of the message that started the thread.

return_route.description: return_route extension; set to all to receive the reply on the same connection.

match.description: PIURI pattern; * matches any run of characters.

text.description: Case-insensitive substring searched in title, summary and tags.

status.description: Keep entries whose status is one of these, e.g. Production.

tags.description: Keep entries carrying at least one of these tags.
